City of Encinitas
Parks and Recreation Commission
AGENDA
TUESDAY, MARCH 15, 2016 -
5:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Housing Element Update - Senior Planner Michael Strong
4B.
EcoFest 2016 - Sandy Atkinson
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES) Each speaker has three (3) minutes to address the Parks and Recreation Commission. There are no time donations during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the Clerk. Direction to staff to bring back a future agenda item or provide additional information to answer a question requires consent of at least two Commission Members.
6.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announce administrative changes to the agenda in compliance with the Brown Act.
7.
APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES
7A.
Approve the February 22, 2016 special meeting minutes.
Agenda Item 7A. Approaval of teh February 22, 2016 Special Meeting Minutes
8.
ACTION ITEMS
8A.
PROPOSED INSTALLATION OF A LITTLE FREE LIBRARY
The Parks and Recreation Commission discuss the proposed installation of a "Little Free Library" box on a City trail easement and provide input for further staff consideration.
Agenda Item 8A. Proposed Installation of a Little Free Library
8B.
PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION CHAIR AND VICE CHAIR
Recommend Action: Elect a Chair and Vice Chair to serve one-year terms.
Agenda Item 8B. Election of Parks and Recreation Commission Chair and Vice Chair
8C.
FY 2015-16 PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION ANNUAL WORK PLAN REVIEW
Recommend Action: Complete the FY2015-16 Work Plan review.
Agenda Item 8C. FY 2015-16 Commission Annual Work Plan Review
8D.
FY 2016-17 PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION ANNUAL WORK PLAN GOAL SETTING
Recommend Action: Discuss and determine FY2016-17 Parks and Recreation Commission Work Plan goals.
Agenda Item 8D. FY 2016-17 Commission Work Plan Goal Setting
8E.
PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION PROPOSED FY 2016-17 MEETING CALENDAR
Recommend Action: Adopt the FY 2016-17 Parks and Recreation Commission proposed meeting calendar.
Agenda Item 8E. FY 2016-17 Commission Meeting Calendar
9.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
9A.
Recreation Services Operations Report
Agenda Item 9A. Recreation Services Operations Report
9B.
Park and Beach Operations Report
Agenda Item 9B. Park and Beach Operations Report
10.
COMMISSION MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM Commissioner prepared and presented agenda items.
10A.
Commission initiated item from Commissioner Marge Kohl regarding memorial and naming request applications for consideration of the Parks and Recreation Commission.
Agenda Item 10A. Commission Initiated Item Naming Request Applications
11.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COMMISSION MEMBERS Commissioners may add future agenda items with consensus of two or more Commissioners.
12.
COMMISSION REPORTS Roundtable
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
